newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ signs repo accord with HK monetary aut.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ signs repo accord with HK monetary aut.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Wednesday it had signed a repurchase agreement with the Hong Kong monetary authority under which either side can call on the other to accept U.S. government securities in exchange for cash.
RBNZ Deputy Governor Murray Sherwin said the agreement was the first of its kind for the bank.
"For us it's an opportunity to participate with our Asian neighbours in a way which is more concrete than anything we've done in the past," he told Reuters.
